prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. "Kanal-Sammler", a huge vaulted underground sewer collector hall below the slums, seen from above. A broad dark-green sewer canal of slowly flowing water runs horizontally straight across the whole middle of the image from the left edge to the right edge; it is NOT walkable. Along both sides of the canal run wide flat walkways of wet grey stone slabs with rusty iron edge railings drawn thin - these two long bands are the large walkable area, with puddles that mirror blue and green glow. Two sturdy flat iron footbridges cross the canal: one left of center, one right of center.
TOP CENTER-LEFT, above the upper walkway: the dry dock of the sewer people - the most eye-catching spot: a drained brick basin turned into a cozy camp, colourful hammocks between pipes, warm yellow string lights zigzagging overhead, a patched tarp tent shack with a little bell and a tin flag (the "town hall"), a mattress bed under a lamp, a small rusty emergency generator with cables, a wooden notice board full of pinned paper scraps (no readable text), the floor of the basin is flat and walkable.
TOP LEFT CORNER: a narrow stone alcove with an iron ladder going straight up through a round manhole in the ceiling, a thick cable hanging down beside it.
TOP CENTER-RIGHT: a solid brick wall section with three round iron grates in a row (shortcut gates), each sealed with a bottle-cap seal, a big red valve wheel cluster with gauges on the wall next to them.
TOP RIGHT: a smuggler's storage nook - stacked crates, cool boxes, a metal shelf with medical cases, a chain-link fence partition, a single cold white lamp. At the far top-right corner a heavy round steel bulkhead door with a big turning wheel.
RIGHT EDGE: the canal and the upper walkway disappear into a dark tunnel arch closed by a rusty iron gate - only darkness behind it.
LEFT EDGE: the canal enters through a giant iron rake grate spanning the water, clogged with floating junk (tyres, bottles, plastic toys, a shopping cart), a small dry niche behind the rake on the far left, glowing mushrooms on the wall.
BOTTOM LEFT: a side chamber with an underground garden - raised beds made of old bathtubs and crates with mint plants and big glowing blue and green mushrooms, a little watering can.
BOTTOM CENTER-LEFT, directly on the lower walkway at the canal edge: a floating trader stall built on a moored raft with a canopy, cooking pot steaming, hanging headlamps and dust masks, lantern light; next to it a small wooden jetty with a raft tied up.
BOTTOM CENTER: a narrow corridor leading down to the bottom edge, ending in a large round pipe opening with ladder rungs (the pipe shaft).
BOTTOM CENTER-RIGHT: a small dead-end chamber with a heap of discarded circuit boards and chips glowing faintly violet, a broken conveyor chute from the ceiling.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a big side chamber, the rat king's throne room: a tall ridiculous throne built entirely from thousands of bottle caps, piles of stolen gears and spare parts, gnawed cables, a dented crown symbol (no letters), entered through a short passage with a crooked wooden gate.
Glowing mushrooms in blue and green dot the walls everywhere, pipes along the vault walls, steam from vents, cables drawn thin so they don't hide the floor. Vaulted brick ceiling is not shown - we look down onto the floor, the hall walls form the top edge.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP LEFT - the iron ladder up through the manhole; BOTTOM edge center - the round pipe shaft opening; RIGHT edge - the gated dark tunnel arch; TOP RIGHT - the round bulkhead door with turning wheel; TOP CENTER-RIGHT - the three round shortcut grates in the wall.
Time: always night underground, damp, lit by glowing mushrooms, string lights and lanterns.
